title: Provision and Landfall
author: Rafael Crane
blurb: Rosalind Reyes, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, has spent seven years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the dry season ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
